acceptanceCriteria: path:line and path[ids] selectors are accepted, recorded as the selection, and each selector reports an outcome including matched-no-example.
Under --exec-prefix the document records Ruby, Bundler and image/container digest observed inside the prefix, or an explicit unknown.
Each example records its shared-example origin file and line when defined in a shared example.
Spec requirements, fail-without-fix tests and a build-log entry are recorded; a real Ruby/container run is evidence or NOT_RUN.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1271: corvint-ruby-test-provider rspec --spec accepts files/dirs only, records no container runtime identity under --exec-prefix (Git observed on host only), and gives no shared-example origin. Owning spec LPCV-V0 (live-proof-carrying-verification-v0, LPCV-V0-090..095 RSpec provider).
title: Ruby test provider: example-level selectors, in-prefix runtime identity and shared-example origin (GitHub #1271)
